page.overview:
What is Ben Tramer?

Bennett "Ben" Samuel Tramer is a character that is first mentioned in the original and appears in . He is the crush of Laurie Strode.

Bennett Tramer was born to Carl and Bonnie Tramer on June 20, 1961, in Haddonfield, Illinois. He is stated to have been liked by Laurie Strode. Annie Brackett learned of this from Laurie, and called him regarding the high school dance.

The following information is only relevant to the 4-6 and H20 Timelines.

On Halloween, he was chased by Dr. Loomis and Sheriff Brackett, who thought he was Michael Myers due to him wearing a similar mask and costume. As Ben crossed a street without looking both ways as he was distracted by the panic, a police vehicle rammed him to a parked van, causing a fiery explosion and instantly killing him.
